page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-3xL4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual server configured on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 16 vCPUs and 192.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 12.0 GB of RAM per core. The server is equipped with three NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPUs, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM.

This server type utilizes a shared CPU allocation model, which may introduce resource contention compared to dedicated CPU instances. Additionally, the instance does not include local storage, requiring external storage attachments for data persistence. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The high density of GPU accelerators and memory relative to the shared CPU allocation positions this instance for workloads that are heavily dependent on GPU parallel processing rather than sustained, high-performance CPU execution. This hardware profile is suitable for machine learning inference, data science jobs, and GPU-accelerated rendering tasks where the shared CPU model and lack of local storage do not bottleneck operations.
